title: I want to create an event animation that is softer than 4 frames.

posts.author: Deeppink_man
posts.body:
I've tried several ways, but I haven't found a solution.
What I want to make is the function of sitting on a table and standing up when you interact with it. All I want is for soft animations to play. But there's a problem with this. I've used multiple methods, but I haven't found a way to play smooth animation within the event. Is there any way to get a smooth animation without getting lagged and putting pressure on the game?

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body:
You can have as many frames as you want by utilizing facing direction and/or stepping frames and a moveroute to display them in the order you want them to.
If you have a lot of stuff that's using more than 3 frames tho, maybe rethinking the engine you're using might be a good idea.

posts.author: KaijuuKimi
posts.body: Artis Impact make use of animated pictures plugin (i dont mean the one created by olivia, it could be any other plugin that animate pictures) and locking the coordinate (im not sure if they use map data variable or plugin). I dont know how exactly they do it but somebody could figure out how to do something similar in mz.

posts.author: TheAM-Dol
posts.body:
If you are willing to spend money, I recommend Rosedale's Character Motion plugin. It allows for unlimited frames. There are 2 important caveats to this:
The creator unfortunately passed away, so there won't be future updates to patch any issues. Users are still able to offer support should you have questions.
The plugin is fully in English which may be a challenge when using it for you. I suppose it depends on how comfortable you are with using translation apps. And, assuming those translation apps do a good job translating the help information.
Character Motions[MV-MZ] by chaucer
Add custom character animations to your game!
chaucer.itch.io
